entries.title: Kamala Harris talking about medical debt - 2024.jpg
entries.description: No one should be denied access to economic opportunity because of a medical emergency. President Biden and I are taking action so that medical debt can’t be included in credit scores, which will ensure more Americans have the freedom to thrive.

entries.title: Figure 4 Allocation of Fees Collected by the Nine Largest Credit Card Issuers for Their Debt Protection Products, 2009 (5578176564).jpg
entries.description: This image is excerpted from a U.S. GAO report: www.gao.gov/products/GAO-11-311 a) Earnings is defined as debt protection product fees collected (revenue) less administrative expenses, company representative incentives, benefits, and increases in reserves, before taxes. b) Administrative expenses and reserves include costs related to administering the product, incentives paid to issuer representatives for enrolling and retaining customers, and the change in reserve requirements between 2008 and 2009. Institutions may be required to establish and maintain appropriate reserves to cover anticipated losses in connection with lending activities. c) Financial benefits to consumers derive from monthly balances, payments, interest, or fees that were canceled for consumers with debt protection products.
entries.creator: U.S. Government Accountability Office from Washington, DC, United States
